verdict.rationale: TWC documents QuickFile, a first-party free tool for reporting more than 1000 employees directly from a formatted file, which is a batch-filing rail rather than purely interactive web entry. The pack does not document system accounts, a transmitter or batch-provider program, or its enrollment path, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. missing for 10: documented transmitter/batch-provider or system-account program, published enrollment path, file-format/API specifications, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published

citations.quote: Install QuickFile for free to report over 1000 employees directly from a formatted file on your computer.
